lines.t: He calls in the whirlwind, his mercy tearing through my pride
Break me open, arms wide, no reason left to hide
Bruised and burning, I fall and confess
Make me undone in your love, nothing lasts
No more these chains, no more disguise
Let it go, let it go I'm giving up my ghost
Consumed by love, you're the fire through my bones
Let it go, let it go Wreck my walls, teach me to see
With the fury of your mercy
Love like you love me
You poured out everything, held nothing back
I'd pour out my heart till the pride all crashed
You'll teach my hands and my sight to be bold
Your love through me, more precious than gold
Call me out, tear me down
In your arms, I'm finally found
Break my silence, flood me with tears
I am yours, no more fear
Let it go, let it go
I'm giving up my goals, consumed by love
You're the fire through my bones
Let it go, let it go
Wreck my walls, teach me to see
With the fury of your mercy
Let it go
Let it go
Let it go
Let it go
Pride to the ashes, heart to the throne
Let it go, let it go
I see the world with your eyes alone
Thank you.
